text:
𝗦𝗪𝗘𝗘𝗣! ♿🇮🇳

India wheelchair team beat Sri Lanka 2-0 in the Beyond Limit Trophy T20Is in Chennai.

Saurabh Malik hit 36* and took 2/6 in game 2 🔥

#WheelchairCricket #TeamIndia

facebook.caption:
𝗪𝗛𝗘𝗘𝗟𝗖𝗛𝗔𝗜𝗥 𝗖𝗥𝗜𝗖𝗞𝗘𝗧 𝗠𝗘𝗜𝗡 𝗜𝗡𝗗𝗜𝗔 𝗞𝗔 𝗦𝗪𝗘𝗘𝗣! ♿🇮🇳

👉 Chennai mein Beyond Limit Trophy ka T20I series 2-0 se jeeta
👉 Match 1: Sri Lanka 62 pe all out, India 7 wicket se jeeta
👉 Match 2: India 8 wicket se jeeta, Saurabh Malik 36* aur 2/6

Wheelchair cricket ko bhi utna hi pyaar milna chahiye. Aap kya kehte ho? Comment karo 👇

#CricketKiBaat #WheelchairCricket #TeamIndia
